name: Rogers-Ramanujan and Schur partition identities in Lean

insights: Gap ≥ 2 between consecutive sorted parts implies all parts are distinct (proved via Pairwise)
rr1Mod5Partitions ⊆ distincts is FALSE: partition 1+1+1=3 has parts ≡ 1 mod 5 but is not distinct
Correct hierarchy: All ⊃ Distinct ⊃ Gap≥2 (RR1) ⊃ Gap≥2+min≥2 (RR2)
Multiset.toList is noncomputable in Mathlib v4.26.0 - prevents native_decide on partition definitions using it
The identities themselves require q-series or bijective proofs (~500+ lines each), correctly axiomatized
builtItems: hasMinGap_two_pairwise_gt: helper lemma proving gap ≥ 2 implies Pairwise (· > ·)
rr1_gap_implies_distinct: main theorem gap ≥ 2 → distinct partitions
rr2_subset_rr1: RR2 gap partitions ⊆ RR1 gap partitions
rr1_gap_subset_distinct: Finset subset version of gap → distinct
